title: The Supremacy of Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The supremacy of Christ means that Jesus is above all creation, powers, rulers, doctrines, ministries, hopes, and names. He is preeminent in all things and worthy of all worship.
summary: The supremacy of Christ means that Jesus is above all creation, powers, rulers, doctrines, ministries, hopes, and names. He is preeminent in all things and worthy of all worship.
christFocus: Jesus is supreme because He is the eternal Son, Creator, Sustainer, Redeemer, Head of the church, risen Lord, and Lamb who is worthy forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture presents Christ as supreme over all things. He is before all things, all things were created through Him and for Him, and in Him all things hold together.

He is supreme in revelation because God has spoken finally in His Son. He is supreme in redemption because peace is made through His blood. He is supreme in the church because He is the Head of the body.

His supremacy includes every power and authority. God has seated Him far above rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name named, both now and in the age to come.

Heaven worships the Lamb who was slain. Christ is not one important part of Christian faith among many. He is the center, Lord, treasure, hope, and final glory of all things.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Ministry, doctrine, worship, and discipleship can drift when Christ is no longer supreme. Good things become dangerous when they take the place only Jesus deserves.

This doctrine recenters everything. The church, the doctrine library, the Bible study tool, and every act of discipleship must exist to exalt Christ above all.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Make Christ supreme in your worship, doctrine, service, decisions, and hopes. Do not let ministry, knowledge, comfort, personality, fear, politics, or spiritual experience take His place. Bow before Him now with joy, because one day every knee will bow.
